title: Sidney De Paris and Joe Thomas in the trumpet section
summary: Dance recalls Sidney De Paris joining after Don Redman; Ramirez remembers players interchanging.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, I know when I heard the band in 1937, he had got Sidney DeParis in the band.
He said something... I was at the Savoy with Helen, and
I remember saying, 'Well, he's so glad to get in this band because he's been with Don Redman, and that's ruining his chops.' Don had him playing very high and hard, you know.
Sidney, let's see... I think he played with us for a certain amount of time before he got in... He and his brother got the (?) band.
Well, I thought Sidney was an excellent trumpet player.
I used to like the way he played. Joe Thomas, too, was very good, wasn't he.
Yeah. We had quite a... We had change... interchanging different guys.
